verdict.rationale: Inbound gating is a fair question for a self-hosted assistant platform. However, the evidence documents no sender allowlists, DM policies or mention gating for inbound messages. RBAC roles (Admin/User/Pending) and webhooks that post into channels are adjacent account and access controls, not gating of who can drive the assistant through messaging surfaces.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
